description: This file defines an immutable class 'ImmutableFunctionExpression' that specifies supported pipeline functions, checks support for function expressions, and resolves such expressions to pipeline elements. It's part of the organizational implementation for function expression handling within the Eclipse Ditto project.

classes.name: ImmutableFunctionExpression
classes.description: An immutable singleton implementation of FunctionExpression that supports specific pipeline functions like filter, default, substring, case conversion, and delete, providing support checks and resolution logic.

methods.name: getPrefix
methods.description: Returns the prefix used for function expressions, likely a constant defined elsewhere.

methods.name: getSupportedNames
methods.description: Returns a list of supported function names.

methods.name: supports
methods.description: Checks whether a given expression name is supported by this expression.

methods.name: resolve
methods.description: Resolves a function expression into a PipelineElement, throwing an exception if unsupported.
